_comment: Every number in 'runs' was MEASURED on the HP ZGX Nano (GB10, aarch64,
CUDA 13, driver 580.173.02) during development on 2026-09-23. Nothing here
is estimated. Projections live in a separate block and are labelled.

telemetry_during_inference.note: nvidia-smi memory.total reports N/A on GB10 (unified memory); per-process memory via --query-compute-apps works

runs.label: MSA generated online via ColabFold server

stage_split._comment: From progress bars in run logs: the dataloader stage reports inference time separately from total wall time.
stage_split.overhead_note: process start, checkpoint load (~2.3 GB) and output writing. This is per-invocation and is what batching amortises.

screening_stage._comment: MHCflurry 2.2.1, CPU only. Measured on an Apple M-series host; the Nano has 20 ARM cores and should be comparable or better.
screening_stage.note: scores mutant AND wild-type peptides, so 3780 predictions total

projections._comment: NOT MEASURED. Derived from the measured single-node numbers above. Label as projections wherever shown.
projections.basis: mean wall time 64.3 s/candidate with cached MSA (n=7 full-setting runs)
assumptions: candidates are independent jobs, so throughput scales with workers
the HLA and B2M MSAs are cached once per patient and reused, so MSA cost is amortised to ~0
no measurement of a second node was possible: only one Nano was available
erosion_factors: per-invocation model load (32 s) unless jobs are batched in one process
storage I/O when writing many structures
sustained thermal/power behaviour over long runs

batched._comment: MEASURED. Five candidates in a single boltz invocation, so the 2.3 GB checkpoint loads once instead of five times.
batched.note: run without a GPU clock cap; boot unchanged, no instability during this run

accuracy_validations.case: KRAS G12D neoepitope GADGVGKSA on HLA-C*08:02
CMV pp65 epitope NLVPMVATV on HLA-A*02:01

accuracy_note: Both validations are RETROSPECTIVE: 6ULN (2020) and 3GSO (2009) predate Boltz-2 and may be in its training data. The claim is reconstruction accuracy on device, not blind prediction.

local_llm.unload: keep_alive:0 frees the GPU for Boltz in ~3 s

ternary_complex._comment: MEASURED. Full pMHC:TCR recognition complex, the step after presentation.
ternary_complex.case: KRAS G12D GADGVGKSA / HLA-C*08:02 / TCR9d from patient 3995 (Sim et al., PNAS 2020; NOT Tran NEJM 2016, which reported the TIL therapy and the epitopes but not this receptor)
ternary_complex.scaling_note: 812 residues took 133 s against 64 s for 383 -- 2.1x residues, 2.1x time
ternary_complex.caveat: Retrospective: 6ULN was published in 2020 and may be in Boltz-2's training data. Also, structural accuracy is NOT immunogenicity -- predicting where a known TCR docks says nothing about whether a T-cell repertoire contains one.
